info.title: EncoreHub Gateway API
info.description: Browser-facing HTTP and SSE contract used by the EncoreHub frontend. Engine-only routes and third-party provider APIs are outside this contract. Every response includes X-Request-ID.

servers.description: Default headless development address; desktop ports are negotiated at runtime.

200.description: JSON response when stream=false, otherwise an SSE stream ending in authoritative done or error data. Streaming delta, reasoning, and usage events may include cumulative provider generation duration_ms; tool execution time is excluded.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a non-default character. Existing conversations retain their immutable character snapshots.

200.description: Character branches and immutable version nodes

post.description: Creates an immutable version from the current working copy and advances the active branch.
Loads an immutable version into the working copy without creating or deleting a version node.
Creates and checks out a branch from an immutable version node.

Validate request-local legacy or versioned API-key pools against draft endpoints without persisting keys or provider profiles. Responses contain only opaque key/endpoint IDs, latency, and structured error categories.

200.description: Per-key credential status and per-endpoint connection health

get.description: Returns an Engine-backed JSON configuration value, or null when the key is unset.

put.description: Stores an opaque JSON configuration value. Secrets must use the Secrets API instead.

post.description: Probe draft endpoints with a legacy single key or versioned API-key pool and return remote model candidates without persisting the profile or keys.

200.description: Structured discovery result, including per-endpoint failures

GatewayBearer.description: Required only when ENCOREHUB_AUTH_TOKEN is configured. Never reuse ENCOREHUB_ENGINE_AUTH_TOKEN.

ProviderKey.name: X-Provider-Key
ProviderKey.description: Optional when the provider secret is available from the unlocked Engine vault. Accepts a legacy single key or EncoreHub's versioned API-key pool envelope; values are never logged or persisted in ProviderProfile.

Character.description: Current version of a character profile

CharacterList.description: Active character profiles; soft-deleted profiles are omitted

CharacterUpgradePreview.description: Diff between the conversation snapshot and the character's current version

character_id.description: Defaults to the stable default character. Provider/model inherit from the selected character when omitted together.

CharacterSnapshot.description: Prompt-bearing character data copied onto a conversation. It is never refreshed implicitly.

revision.description: Optimistic lock for the mutable working copy.

replace_message_id.description: User message ID to replace before regenerating the conversation from that turn

date.description: Current date reported by the user's system

time.description: Current local time reported by the user's system

timezone.description: IANA timezone reported by the user's system, with a UTC offset fallback

key_routing_strategy.description: Selection policy for the separately encrypted API-key pool.

id.description: Exact model value sent in provider API requests.

name.description: Optional local display note or alias; never sent to the provider API.
